description: This file defines the PublicStream class, a Drupal stream wrapper for handling publicly accessible files, including methods for retrieving URLs, paths, and configuration settings related to public file storage.

classes.name: PublicStream
classes.description: A Drupal stream wrapper class for public files, extending LocalStream, providing URL and path handling for publicly accessible files.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of stream wrapper, indicating local normal storage.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name 'Public files' for this stream wrapper.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description indicating the stream serves public local files.

methods.name: getDirectoryPath
methods.description: Returns the base directory path for the public stream.

methods.name: getExternalUrl
methods.description: Generates the external URL for a public file, encoding the target path.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Static method to find the base URL for public files, using settings or global base URL.

methods.name: basePath
methods.description: Static method to determine the base path for public files, considering site configuration and kernel services.

methods.name: getLocalPath
methods.description: Returns the local filesystem path for a given URI, with overrides for virtual filesystems and private paths.
